svg.text: Pay once or a clear price,

circle.title: Infomaniak Site Creator (source: landscape) Drag-and-drop builder for showcase sites, blogs and shops, 50+ themes, AI-assisted creation (read via search snippet; page body did not load). Price: Tiers: free (1 page, no custom domain, ads), Lite (6 pages, 15 GB), Pro (unlimited pages, 50 GB, e-commerce); currency and billing period not found; included free with a hosting plan.. https://www.infomaniak.com/en/create-a-website/site-creator (read 2026-11-22); flagged for re-read by landscape.d

saldiaBuild (source: landscape) AI website builder: describe the site in plain words and the AI builds the pages; sold as hosted in Switzerland. Price: not found on the page read. https://www.saldia.ch/en (read 2026-11-22)

IONOS MyWebsite (source: landscape) Builder (MyWebsite Now) in Starter, Plus and Pro plus store variants; domain, SSL and email included. Price: Shown in $ on the .com page, monthly on a 1-year term: Starter $6 then $14, Plus $1 then $20, Pro $17; stores higher; 30-day money-back.. https://www.ionos.com/websites/website-builder (read 2026-11-22)

Jimdo (source: landscape) Website and store builder with add-ons (listings, bookings, forms, payments, invoicing) and the Companion AI assistant; free start without a card. Price: Plans Free, Start, Grow, Complete, Unlimited; per-plan prices not shown on the page read; terms monthly, 12 or 24 months, auto-renewing, EUR incl. VAT; domain EUR 26/yr after first term; 0% sales commission.. https://www.jimdo.com/ (read 2026-11-22)

Hostinger Website Builder (source: landscape) Drag-and-drop builder with templates, AI site generation, hosting, domain, ecommerce and marketing tools, 14-day free trial. Price: USD, paid over 48 months: Premium $1.99/mo (renews $10.99), Unlimited $2.79 (renews $16.99), Cloud Startup $7.99 (renews $25.99); 30-day money-back.. https://www.hostinger.com/website-builder (read 2026-11-22); flagged for re-read by landscape.d

Framer (source: landscape) In $ (currency unnamed): Free $0, Basic $10/mo, Pro $30/mo, Enterprise custom; overages per unit (e.g. $50 per 100 GB bandwidth, $20 per extra editor). Price: In $ (currency unnamed): Free $0, Basic $10/mo, Pro $30/mo, Enterprise custom; overages per unit (e.g. $50 per 100 GB bandwidth, $20 per extra editor).. https://www.framer.com/pricing (read 2026-11-22)
Hugo (source: landscape) Open-source static site generator in Go, says it is very fast. Price: Software free; no hosting product or price on the homepage.. https://gohugo.io/ (read 2026-11-22)

Jekyll (source: landscape) Turns Markdown, Liquid, HTML and CSS into a static site; no database. Price: software free (see licence fact); hosting and any AI key cost extra. https://jekyllrb.com/ (read 2026-11-22)

Eleventy (source: landscape) Static site generator from a folder of Markdown, HTML or custom files; calls itself stable, secure and privacy-focused. Price: No price; sponsor-funded.. https://www.11ty.dev/ (read 2026-11-22)

Astro (source: landscape) JavaScript framework for content-driven sites sending light HTML. Price: software free (see licence fact); hosting and any AI key cost extra. https://astro.build/ (read 2026-11-22)

Zola (source: landscape) Static site engine as one executable with Sass and syntax highlighting built in. Price: software free (see licence fact); hosting and any AI key cost extra. https://www.getzola.org/ (read 2026-11-22); flagged for re-read by landscape.d
WordPress (source: landscape) Open-source publishing software on PHP and MariaDB behind millions of sites. Price: software free; hosting extra. https://wordpress.org/about/ (read 2026-11-22)

Ghost (source: landscape) MIT. Price: Managed Ghost(Pro), billed yearly, in $: Starter $18/mo, Publisher $29/mo, Business $199/mo, Custom.. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TryGhost/Ghost/main/LICENSE (read 2026-11-22)

bolt.diy (source: landscape) Community fork of bolt.new: browser workspace to prompt, edit, run and deploy full-stack apps with any LLM. Price: Software free; you pay your LLM provider or use local models.. https://github.com/stackblitz-labs/bolt.diy (read 2026-11-22)

Dyad (source: landscape) Local open-source AI app builder positioned against Lovable, v0 and Bolt; for power users. Price: Free download; bring your own AI API keys.. https://github.com/dyad-sh/dyad (read 2026-11-22)

tinykit (source: landscape) Self-hostable AI app builder on PocketBase, billed as a Lovable/v0 alternative with built-in database. Price: software free (see licence fact); hosting and any AI key cost extra. https://github.com/tinykit-studio/tinykit (read 2026-11-22)

AI App Builder Open (Totalum) (source: landscape) Prompt-to-Next.js app builder with live preview, GitHub sync and custom domains. Price: Code free; Totalum key free to start with 50 AI credits, then usage-based.. https://github.com/totalumlabs/ai-app-builder-open (read 2026-11-22)

Own it and move it, with no technical skill (nobody found in rings 1 and 3) (source: cartographer) In rows.json no player serves both pn-own-it-move-it and pn-no-technical-skill: ring 1 builders lack the first, ring 3 tools lack the second. Absence in rings 1 and 3 only; rings 2 and 4 are not yet read, and "lacks" means no export path found on the pages read, not proof none exists

svg.text: Own it and move it, with
Green: user need. Purple: the shared goal. Blue: component. Red ring: a gap (named as missing in the sources). Orange arrow: a suggested move, for strategy.d. Positions are a reading of the sources.
